notes.title: Games Release and First Update
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

I'm super excited to share that my first two games launched on Steam just a couple of days ago! 🎉
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45236386/2aa53b7692f22ef5ce0b7e78ef615c074e816883.gif[/img]
Also, I just released an update for 101 Playland Dogs: Find & Paint, here's the changes:
[list][*] [b]Achievements Update:[/b] Achievements will now unlock individually as you discover each dog, instead of all unlocking at once after finishing the game. 
[*] [b]Auto-Save for Progress:[/b] Your game progress will now save automatically
[*] [b]Save Settings:[/b] Changes to settings will now be saved. 
[*] [b]Progress Reset Option:[/b] Added an option in the options menu to reset game progress and achievements. [/list]
If you run into any issues, feel free to reach out. Thanks so much for the support, and happy gaming!

Check out my other game on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3210730/101_Cute_Dogs_Find__Paint/
And take a look at the full bundle:
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/46509/101_Cute_Dogs__Master_Bundle/

Thank you!
